holdout.estimand: Each world averages strict request rates across the island champions. Double-key rate pools both-strict pairs and all eligible pairs across islands.

receipt.estimand: Per-world change in each receipt effect, conditioning on eligible events separately for each arm and generation. A conditional pair contributes only if both sides have eligible events. Eligibility itself uses all opportunities and is reported alongside the effects.

uncertainty: 95% percentile intervals from 10000 resamples of the paired world deltas. The intervals describe world-to-world variation for these checkpoints from one evolutionary run.
